verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of inviting an external accountant or bookkeeper, or of role-scoped permissions for such a user. Accountant-facing marketing (client migration) and multi-entity management under one login are adjacent features, not a documented invite-with-roles capability, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
